lines.en: I drift slowly between the coral branches.

lines.zh: 我的身体一收一放地游。
lines.en: I swim by squeezing and releasing my body.
The warm water turns me in slow circles.
I ride a finger's width above the sand.
The gills on my back sway as I go.
The coral is thick; I turn sideways to pass.
A school of small fish swims along with me.

lines.zh: 我游得不快，颜色倒是很亮。
lines.en: I swim slowly, but my colors are bright.
I round a purple coral head.

lines.zh: 水面上的光在晃，我也晃。
lines.en: The light above wavers, and so do I.
I float over the seagrass.

lines.zh: 我身后拖出一道浅浅的痕。
lines.en: A faint trail follows behind me.
The tide moves shoreward; I go with it.
I pause and let a turtle pass.
I creep over the coral on my foot.
A shoal of shrimp parts to let me pass.
I rest on the coral, swaying with the water.
My colors are slowly fading.
Bubbles rise in steady strings.
The taste of kelp is close by.
I open my gills and sift the water.

lines.zh: 一条小丑鱼在我旁边绕。
lines.en: A clownfish circles beside me.
The seabed is so quiet I seem absent.
I spread out limply on the rock.
I release one bubble, slowly.
Twenty-five points is enough for a long lazy life.
I am waiting for the water to warm a little.

lines.zh: 珊瑚的影子落在我背上。
lines.en: Coral shadows fall across my back.
I twitch my rhinophores, then stop.
Nine slots of storage; empty is fine too.

lines.zh: 你憋着气游下来，脸都红了。
lines.en: You dive holding your breath, your face red.
Your flippers kick up sand.
I drift up to your face mask.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我就缩回珊瑚里。
lines.en: You reach out; I shrink back into the coral.

lines.zh: 我在看你身上那些亮片。
lines.en: I am looking at the shiny bits on you.
You are far clumsier in water than I am.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛长在触角上，看你。
lines.en: My eyes sit on stalks, and they see you.
Your bubbles are bigger than mine.
You stepped on coral; go gently.
I circle you once, then once more.
A cut has opened along my body.
I curl up and my colors dim.
That blow landed on my gills.

lines.zh: 被撞得翻过来，露出肚皮。
lines.en: The hit flipped me over, belly up.
Do not touch; my skin is very thin.
The pain makes me pull my rhinophores in.
Twenty-five points, and I lost a fair share.
I retreat deeper into the coral.
The wound throbs in the water.
I sink slowly down onto the sand.
Kelp; I want that long strip.

lines.zh: 你手里绿色的东西是给我的？
lines.en: Is that green thing in your hand for me?

lines.zh: 我闻到海带的腥甜味了。
lines.en: I smell the salt-sweet of kelp.
Bring it closer; I cannot reach.
I float up slowly; do not rush.
Kelp tastes much better than coral.
I curl around it and nibble bit by bit.
Your hand is wrinkled from the water.
This will feed me for a while.
I am not picky, as long as it is green.
You bump me and I bounce away, soft.
A bump underwater does not hurt.
I press against your leg and slide off.
Do not push with your hand; I tear easily.
We collide and drift apart again.

lines.zh: 我的触角碰到你的面罩。
lines.en: My rhinophore touched your mask.
Your knee is harder than the coral.
I shift aside to let you pass.
After the bump a few grains of sand fall off me.

lines.zh: 浪把我们俩挤在一块珊瑚上。
lines.en: A wave pressed us both onto one coral head.

lines.zh: 我顺着海带的味道找她。
lines.en: I follow the scent of kelp to find her.
Her colors are gaudier than mine.
We lie side by side on the coral.
In the warm water we turn slowly together.
I give her the tenderest kelp.
Do not dive too close; we dislike the stir.

lines.zh: 我们的卵会漂在珊瑚间。
lines.en: Our eggs will drift among the coral.
She moves once; I move once.
This reef can hold us for a long time.
I circle her, round and round.
Nine slots means I cannot take much.

lines.zh: 我用身体卷住这块海带。
lines.en: I wrap my body around this kelp.
This shell is bright; I will bring it.
Too heavy; it sinks away from me.

lines.zh: 我把珊瑚碎片推进行囊。
lines.en: I nudge coral fragments into my bags.
Something in this grain of sand glints.
I pick it up, and drop it again.

lines.zh: 海草缠在我身上，也算我的。
lines.en: Seagrass tangled on me; I count it as mine.
That shell was mine before you swam here.
Carry too much and I cannot swim.
Something is moving behind the coral.
The water's taste changed; there is blood.

lines.zh: 水面上有块黑影压下来。
lines.en: A dark shape is bearing down from above.
I hear the sound of a paddle in water.
Something has broken the coral branches.
It is coming toward my side.
I raise my head and my gills flare.
That fish is nibbling my kelp.

lines.zh: 水流带来了陌生的味道。
lines.en: The current carries an unfamiliar scent.
I tuck into a coral crack and watch it.
I hug the sandy floor without a ripple.

lines.zh: 它往下潜，我就往边上挪。
lines.en: It dives; I slide to the side.

lines.zh: 我的颜色变得跟珊瑚一样。
lines.en: My colors have matched the coral.
It reaches out; I retract my gills.
I am waiting for it to touch me first.
It circles in; I circle out.
I am soft, but I do not go down easy.
The current pushed it half a step closer.
I fix on the net at its waist.
It backs off, so I uncoil my body.
I slap it once with my body.
I bite its finger; it slips free.
This blow carries only three points.
I spray sour fluid onto its hand.
I bump its mask and bounce back.
It grabs me; I twist loose.
My rhinophore flicks its wrist.
It cannot shout; bubbles rise instead.
Afterward I squeeze into a reef crack.

lines.zh: 我不凶，我只是不想被吃。
lines.en: I am not fierce; I just refuse to be eaten.

lines.zh: 我在温水珊瑚边慢慢成形。
lines.en: I take shape by the warm-water coral.

lines.zh: 海水是暖的，珊瑚是粉的。
lines.en: The sea is warm and the coral is pink.

lines.zh: 我第一次张开背上的鳃。
lines.en: I open the gills on my back for the first time.

lines.zh: 鱼群绕着我转了一圈就散。
lines.en: The fish circled me once, then scattered.
The sand is soft; I settle onto it.
The light here is blue.

lines.zh: 我顺着礁石慢慢爬了一段。
lines.en: I crawl a little way along the reef.
The tide carried me away from the egg mass.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着出生的颜色。
lines.en: I still wear the colors I was born with.
This reef is my home now.
Hot water scalded me; I flee.

lines.zh: 被浪甩上礁石，我干着急。
lines.en: A wave threw me onto the reef; I gasp.

lines.zh: 一出水，背上的鳃就瘫了。
lines.en: Once beached, the gills on my back collapse.

lines.zh: 水底一声闷响，我耳朵疼。
lines.en: A muffled blast undersea; my ears ache.
A harpoon grazed my back.

lines.zh: 那股凉意钻进我的软肉。
lines.en: That chill seeped into my soft flesh.
Hungry this long, even my colors faded.

lines.zh: 电在水里窜，我的触角僵了。
lines.en: The current ran through the water; my stalks froze.

lines.zh: 下面深得没有底，我不敢看。
lines.en: The drop below has no bottom; I will not look.
